content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
content_sections.text: The exact date on which the online application link was activated is not mentioned in the notification. Candidates are advised to check upanganwadibharti.in for the live application link.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Worker Vacancy 2026 - Project-wise Details
content_sections.text: The 250 posts are distributed across 12 Child Development Project (Bal Vikas Pariyojana) areas in Saharanpur district. The table below shows the number of posts along with the category-wise reservation break-up (Unreserved - UR, Other Backward Class - OBC, Scheduled Caste - SC, Scheduled Tribe - ST) for each project. The notification also states that the ward/gram sabha-wise breakup along with full eligibility and reservation details has been displayed on the notice boards of the District Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, Tehsil, and Vikas Khand offices, and is also uploaded on upanganwadibharti.in .

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for the Anganwadi Worker post. The applicant must be a resident of the same ward/gram sabha where the vacant post exists. If an eligible candidate from the applicable category is not available in that ward/gram sabha, a resident of the concerned Nyay Panchayat becomes eligible. The minimum educational qualification for the Anganwadi Worker post is Intermediate (12th pass) or an equivalent qualification. Merit for selection will be determined on the basis of educational qualification ranging from Intermediate up to Postgraduate level - candidates with higher qualifications (up to postgraduate) may receive merit advantage as per departmental norms. Age relaxation details for reserved categories, if any, are not specified in this notification.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Worker 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: The Anganwadi Karyakartri post is a honorarium-based (Manadeya) engagement. The specific monthly honorarium amount is not mentioned in this notification. Candidates may contact the Child Development Project Office or the District Program Officer (Bal Vikas Vibhag) office, Saharanpur, for the current honorarium structure.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Worker Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee details for this recruitment are not mentioned in the notification. Candidates are advised to check the official website upanganwadibharti.in at the time of filling the online form for any applicable fee.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of merit determined from the candidate's educational qualification (from Intermediate to Postgraduate level), combined with the following priority (Variyata) order applicable within the eligible ward/gram sabha: A widow, legally divorced, or deserted woman belonging to a family living below the poverty line (BPL), resident of the same gram sabha/ward (urban areas). If such a candidate is not available, any other woman from a BPL family in the same gram sabha/ward. If no candidate is found under the above categories, a widow/divorced/deserted woman from a family living above the poverty line, in the same order of priority. If still not found, women from families living above the poverty line. If no eligible candidate is available in the gram sabha under any of the above categories, selection will be made category-wise from the concerned Nyay Panchayat. Applications for a post reserved for a specific category will be accepted only from candidates belonging to that category. Posts under the unreserved category are open to candidates of any caste.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates (Intermediate to Postgraduate, as applicable) Residence certificate - must be online, digitally signed, and issued by the Tehsil Caste certificate - must be online, digitally signed, and issued by the Tehsil Income certificate (for BPL category claims) - must be online, digitally signed, and issued by the Tehsil Death certificate (for widow candidates) - must be certified by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the concerned municipal body Legal divorce/desertion order (for divorced or deserted women) - must be issued by a competent court The notification clearly states that only online, digitally signed documents from the Tehsil will be accepted for residence, caste, and income proof; manually issued or offline certified copies will not be considered valid.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for UP Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Applications can be submitted only through the official website. Offline application forms or documents submitted through any other mode will not be accepted or recognized.
